title: Environment descriptions (environments.yaml)
description: Optional. Describes the local/dev/staging/production environments a task can target (T43), so every agent's prompt can say which one it's in instead of only devops finding out at deploy time. The four names are fixed — this file only adds description/requires_approval metadata for names an agent already knows about; it does not invent new environment names. Absence is not an error: every project has the four built-in generic descriptions even with no file at all.

version.description: Schema generation of this file. Bumped only when a change would break an existing reader.

environments.description: Metadata for one or more of the four fixed environment names. An environment this file doesn't mention still exists — it just uses the built-in generic description.

default.description: Which environment a task gets when --env is not passed. Must name an environment declared above. When this key is absent, the built-in default (local) applies.

description.description: What this environment is, in the words an agent should treat as ground truth instead of assuming.

requires_approval.description: Descriptive only — this file does not itself gate anything (see T44 for prepare-vs-execute deploy approval). Records the project's own policy so a person reading this file, or a future checker, has one place to look.
